descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# **Pro Soccer Nations**

Experience the excitement of international soccer (football) in VR! Take control of your field players and compete for glory in immersive full-length matches against intelligent AI opponents—all **offline**, no internet required.

Choose from **200+ national teams** and compete in world and continental tournaments, or create your own custom competitions with your favorite nations and rules.

Built specifically for virtual reality, Pro Soccer Nations features comfortable movement designed to minimize VR discomfort while keeping you fully immersed in the action.

**Features**

* 200+ national teams
* World & continental tournaments
* Create custom tournaments
* Control all field players
* Intelligent AI opponents
* Multiple difficulty levels
* Various formations
* Comfortable VR gameplay
* Fully offline—no internet required

# **Lead Your Nation to Glory**

Every pass matters.

Every tackle counts.

Every goal brings you one step closer to becoming world champion.

Put on your headset, step onto the pitch, and experience the passion, excitement, and drama of international soccer in Pro Soccer Nations.

# **List of predefined tournaments**
 * World: 1994-2026
 * Europe: 1996-2024
 * South America: 2007-2024
 * North America: 2009-2025
 * Africa: 2008-2025
 * Asia: 2007-2023
 * Oceania: 2012-2024

You can play them as is or modify the teams. 
For totally custom tournaments you can select 32, 24 or 16 teams template.
